Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and wood and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Wood and Metal. Colour: Green. Stated size: 150 cm. Product weight: 5.1 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.

REUSABLE CHRISTMAS BAUBLES & CONVENIENT STORAGE - Designed for seasonal use year after year, these velvet Christmas decorations retain their attractive appearance with appropriate care. The set comes in a clear plastic storage box to keep all 6 Christmas baubles organised between holidays.

Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Shatter Resistant Design
The ornaments use a shatter resistant construction for the stated decorative use. They provide an alternative to traditional glass decorations when arranging the display, while retaining a defined shape and finish for the festive setting.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Champagne and Gold. Quantity: 62 pack.
Reusable plastic baubles with shatter resistant design for safe festive decorating.
Decorative pine cone and snowflake details add texture to your Christmas tree display.
Shimmering glitter finish provides a light catching accent for coordinated seasonal arrangements.
Includes 62 champagne and gold ornaments to create a focal point on your holiday decor.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering
Included: 62 Christmas baubles

Versatile Decor & Perfect Gift Idea
Equipped with a hook, this charming hot air balloon light can be easily hung in bedrooms, living rooms, patios, or even
cafes and garden pergolas,. It's not just for Christmas – it adds a touch of whimsy to birthdays, weddings, baby showers,
or everyday home decor. Thoughtfully designed and universally loved, it makes a wonderful Christmas gift for family, friends,
and anyone who appreciates a little holiday magic.
Magical Design & Festive Atmosphere
This enchanting hot air balloon lamp features a classic red and white striped balloon and a delightful Santa Claus figurine
sitting in the woven basket. It instantly transforms any room into a cozy winter wonderland, filling your space with the magic
and joy of Christmas. Whether placed on a mantel, hung from the window, or displayed near the Christmas tree, this stunning
piece captures the holiday spirit like no other.
Product Specifications
Product Name: LED Santa Claus Hot Air Balloon
Product Dimensions: 30 × 21 × 100 cm
Batteries: 3 AAA batteries (not included)
Light Colors: Warm light
Protection Rating: IP44
【Magical Christmas Decoration】: Transform your home into a winter wonderland with this unique hot air balloon lantern. Featuring classic red and white striped balloons and a charming Santa Claus figure nestled in the woven basket, this Christmas lamp instantly becomes the focal point of any room. The warm, inviting glow creates a cozy fairy-tale atmosphere that both kids and adults will adore, making it the ultimate Holiday Decoration for your living room, mantel, or entryway.
【8 Lighting Modes & Timer Function】: Easily switch among 8 dynamic lighting effects – steady on, slow fade, twinkling, chasing, wave, and more – with the button on the battery case. Adjust the brightness level to suit any mood, from a soft nightlight to a brilliant festive glow. The default timer is preset to automatically turn the lights on for 6 hours, then off for 18 hours in a repeating cycle, so you never need to worry about manual shut‑off. This smart cycle saves battery and lets the lamp run effortlessly while you sleep or go out, making it simple to personalise your holiday ambiance.
【Battery-Powered】: Say goodbye to messy cords and limited outlets! Powered by 3 AA batteries (not included), this lamp is completely wireless. What sets it apart is the upgraded waterproof battery case, which protects the power source from light rain or snow. This means you can safely display it on your front porch, patio, or balcony without worrying about the elements—bringing festive cheer both indoors and outdoors.
【Versatile Decoration for Any Space】: This charming hot air balloon light comes with a handy hook, making it incredibly easy to hang wherever you like. Suspend it in your bedroom for a dreamy nightlight, display it in the living room as a festive centerpiece, or hang it on the patio to welcome guests with a warm glow. Its classic design blends seamlessly into any setting, adding a touch of sparkling brilliance to Christmas.
【The Perfect Christmas Gift for All Ages】: Looking for a special present? This whimsical balloon light is the ideal Christmas Gift for family, friends, neighbors, or even as a hostess gift for holiday parties. It’s a thoughtful and unique surprise that spreads joy long after the holidays are over. Perfect for teens, adults, and seniors who appreciate a touch of holiday magic.

8956086439918.variantName: 122 cm Navy Blue Ruffled Velvet Christmas Tree Skirt, 48 Inch, Pleated Edge, Festive Home Decor for New Year Holiday Party
8956086439918.sourceDescription:
A navy velvet tree skirt, 122 cm, with a pleated edge and tie fastening. Navy is the underrated one: it looks smart with silver, and it does not turn the corner into a grotto.

The velvet drapes softly and the pleated border gives the hem a bit of movement. The centre opening ties at the back, so it goes round the stand in one go. At 122 cm it is sized for 6 to 7 ft trees and gives presents somewhere to sit. It also works under a mantel garland if you want the colour repeated. Hand wash cold or spot clean, then dry flat and store rolled to keep the pleats.

Try it with silver, white and a little glass.

Material: Velvet
122 cm navy velvet skirt with pleated edge
Navy reads smart with silver and glass decorations
Tie fastening at the centre opening
Sized for 6 to 7 ft trees, room for presents
Hand wash cold, dry flat, store rolled

Christmas Tree Decorations
These Christmas tree decorations add a festive detail to your Christmas display. The silver finish and metal construction give them a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Metal. Colour: Silver. Stated size: 2.4 x 1 cm. Quantity: 50 pack.
Compact metal ornaments measuring just 2.4 x 1 cm, ideal for adding detail to smaller trees or tight spaces.
Pack of 50 festive silver hanging decorations provides ample quantity for full tree coverage and gifting.
Durable metal construction with a sleek silver finish ensures a defined appearance that lasts through the season.
Versatile compact design allows easy storage and flexible placement within any Christmas display arrangement.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use

8941467526318.baseName: Christmas Tree Ornaments Clear Acrylic Crystal Look Snowflake and Icicle 18 Pack with Hanging Ribbons
8941467526318.variantName: Christmas Tree Ornaments Clear Acrylic Crystal Look Snowflake and Icicle 18 Pack with Hanging Ribbons
8941467526318.sourceDescription:
These Christmas tree ornaments are precision cut from clear acrylic rather than real crystal or glass. The multi-faceted surface catches tree lights and throws an icy sparkle close to glass, yet each piece is very light, so it will not pull branch tips down, and it will not shatter into sharp shards if a child, cat or vacuum knocks it off the tree.

The set holds 18 pieces in 7 styles: 2 large starburst snowflake drops at 7.5 in, 2 large starburst snowflake drops at 7.2 in, 1 classic snowflake drop at 5.35 in, 2 double snowflake drops at 7 in, 1 double snowflake drop at 5 in, 5 twisted icicles at 5.31 in and 5 octagon bead strands at 4.8 in. Mixing the lengths is what makes a tree look styled rather than patchy, so hang the long drops near the branch tips and the shorter ones further in.

Every set includes ready cut 3.94 in white hanging ribbons. The loops arrive untied to avoid tangling in transit, so thread each ribbon through its ring before hanging. No extra hooks are needed. Hang them on tree branches, wreaths, mantel garland, stair rails, doorframes and windows, or use them for winter weddings, children's birthdays and winter wonderland parties.

Keep the ornaments indoors or on a covered porch rather than in open weather, as prolonged sun and rain can dull clear acrylic over time. Each piece is individually padded for storage, and if anything arrives cracked, contact us and we will send a replacement.

Add a delicate, colour-changing sparkle with these RGB mini seed string lights from MySmartBuy. Tiny micro LEDs on an elegant silver wire glow in any colour you choose. Control them with the Hello Fairy app or remote. They are lovely on Christmas trees and in bedrooms, living rooms, patios and conservatories, indoors or out. Choose a single colour to match your decor, or let them cycle through shades for a playful party mood, and use them long after Christmas for birthdays and celebrations. Festive lights are among the most versatile decorations you can own. Use them to outline windows and doors, wrap trees and railings, or layer them with light up figures and wreaths to tie a whole display together. Versatile and easy to use, they are a quick way to transform your home and garden for the festive season, and can be brought out again year after year. At a glance: RGB mini seed string lights | micro LEDs | silver wire | Hello Fairy app and remote | indoor and outdoor use.
RGB MINI SEED STRING LIGHTS : Colour-changing micro LEDs on an elegant silver wire.
DELICATE SPARKLE : Tiny seed LEDs for a fine, magical glow.
APP AND REMOTE CONTROL : Change colours, effects and brightness from your phone with the Hello Fairy app or the included remote.
YEAR-ROUND LIGHTING : Not just for Christmas.
VERSATILE : Christmas trees, bedrooms, living rooms, patios and conservatories.

5096042276218.baseName: Christmas wreath - Festive door decoration - Red berries and pine needles for hanging on a door or wall - Green and red, 35 cm
5096042276218.variantName: Christmas wreath - Festive door decoration - Red berries and pine needles for hanging on a door or wall - Green and red, 35 cm
5096042276218.sourceDescription:
Bright red berries stand out against fine artificial pine needles. The plastic construction recreates the shapes and texture of winter foliage in a 35 cm wreath that you can take down and display again.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. Small red berries show especially clearly against a simple backdrop. If you want to tie the wreath into a larger Christmas scheme, repeat their red in a nearby ornament and let the foliage provide the quieter colour.

When you unpack the greenery, support the wreath from behind and ease any compressed outer sprigs apart gently. Turn the wreath as you work so that you can check the outline from the front as well as from the side.

To carry the colours into the rest of the room, pick out one detail from the wreath and repeat it in wrapping ribbon, a table runner or decorations on the tree. Even a single matching accent can bring two separate displays together. After the festive season, lay the decoration in a box with space around its edges. Keep heavy ornaments and tightly coiled strings of lights separate so that the front of the wreath keeps its shape in storage.

A narrow ribbon in a colour taken from the design makes a discreet finishing touch if you use your own hanger. Varying the length of the ribbon lets you line up the centre of the wreath with a panel or a nearby mirror. Hung on a panelled door, a wreath looks best when the edges of the panel still show. Centre it on the panel itself and look at it from the far end of the hall before choosing the final hanging height.

A plain background lets you see the smaller details even from the other side of the room.
Artificial pine needles and red berries create a festive look without the need for watering or maintenance.
Compact 35 cm diameter design is ideal for hanging on doors or walls in spaces where a full-sized tree is not feasible.
Durable plastic construction ensures the wreath retains its shape and colour, allowing it to be stored and reused year after year.
Ready-made one-piece outline provides an instant decorative statement with no assembly required for immediate display.
Comes with None

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details

Festive Father Christmas motif adds a recognisable seasonal character to your home decor.
Versatile fabric wreath designed as a practical decorative detail for doors or walls.
Single set quantity provides an easy-to-display focal point for Christmas arrangements.
Soft fabric construction allows gentle handling and flexible positioning within displays.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

Christmas Garland
This Christmas garland adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Green. Stated size: 6 m. Quantity: 3 pack.
Includes three festive green plastic Christmas garlands for versatile home decoration.
Each garland measures six metres in length to provide ample coverage for displays.
Durable plastic construction ensures a defined appearance suitable for repeated use.
Designed specifically to add a festive detail and focal point to your Christmas display.
Guarantee - 1 month

Warm White Light
Warm white illumination gives the display a softer colour tone. It can be paired with surrounding decorative lighting to create a coordinated appearance in the intended setting.

Light with a purpose
Place the light where its effect will be most useful within the intended setting. The position influences how the surrounding surfaces look, so consider nearby furniture, reflective finishes and the direction from which the light will be viewed.

Build a considered arrangement
Lighting can help define a particular part of a room or display. Combine the product with the lighting already present and adjust its position to create the balance you want, allowing practical room lighting and decorative accents to work together.

Make the most of the design
Give the light enough surrounding space for its shape and illumination to be appreciated. A clear position helps prevent neighbouring objects from obscuring the effect and makes the product easier to reach for ordinary operation or care.

Coordinate your decor
The listed finish can be paired with existing accessories or used as a contrasting detail. Lighting is both a functional and decorative part of an arrangement, so its appearance when switched off can also contribute to the overall setting.

Arrange before use
Set up the light according to its supplied instructions and choose a compatible power supply where required. Position any lead so that the installation remains orderly, and keep access available for switching the product off or disconnecting it.

Christmas Elf Decoration

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Woven Texture
The woven construction gives the surface a structured textile pattern. Its visible texture adds detail to the overall appearance.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

5056214068218.sourceDescription:
Bring a touch of traditional charm to your festive displays with Santa's Secret! A clever 4-in-1 Christmas figurine set designed in the style of Russian nesting dolls.

Standing 16cm tall when assembled, this adorable Santa figure opens to reveal a snowman, which hides a penguin, and finally, a tiny tree. Each piece is made from smooth, hand-painted wood and carefully crafted with cheerful expressions, bright colours, and festive details.

These are brilliant for creating an eye-catching shelf or mantel display, or adding a fun talking point to your Christmas table. Lightweight and compact, they're ideal for those looking to add festive cheer without taking up too much space.

Indoor use only, these figurines should be stored in a dry place after the season to ensure years of enjoyment. They work beautifully alongside other wooden or traditional-style décor and make a fun contrast to more modern Christmas pieces.
RUSSIAN DOLL STYLE: Four festive favourites in one clever design. Santa opens to reveal a snowman, then a penguin, and finally a tiny Christmas tree. All neatly nested together.
HAND-PAINTED WOODEN DESIGN: Made from durable, smooth wood with colourful hand-painted details, giving each figure its own quirky charm and timeless appeal.
FUN FESTIVE GIFT IDEA: A brilliant present for children or anyone who loves a touch of festive fun. Small enough to display anywhere, big enough to delight.
DETAILS: Supplied as a set of four hand-painted wooden figurines in Russian doll format. For indoor use only.
ABOUT US: At YouGarden, we believe that gardening is for everyone. Based in rural Lincolnshire we have our own 11 acre nursery, meaning that we are in close contact with our plants, so that we can guarantee our plants will thrive because we've grown them ourselves. We also source product locally, nationally and internationally to ensure we give our customers the best range, highest quality and greatest value for money. All our products will arrive in nursery fresh condition.

5059442204618.variantName: Fraser Fir Pot Grown Christmas Tree - Real Live Fresh Living Potted Plant - 6ft (180cm) · 本规格 / Selected: 6ft
5059442204618.sourceDescription:
With its classic Christmas-tree shape and naturally dense growth, a pot-grown Fraser Fir makes a traditional choice for the festive season while offering something extra beyond December. The rich green foliage forms neat layers of branches that are easy to decorate, while the short, soft needles and good needle retention help it remain an attractive feature throughout the celebrations. This real Christmas tree has also been grown in a pot from the outset, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container before sale.
CLASSIC CHRISTMAS CHARACTER: Naturally conical and densely branched, Fraser Fir has the traditional Christmas-tree shape many people look for, with rich green foliage that creates a full appearance without needing excessive decoration. The branches provide plenty of room for lights, baubles, and other festive favourites.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
SOFT NEEDLES, LASTING DISPLAY: Fraser Fir has relatively soft needles that are pleasant to handle when decorating, while its needle retention helps it maintain a full appearance throughout the festive period. The foliage also releases a fresh, characteristic fir fragrance, adding another familiar part of the real Christmas tree experience.
FROM CHRISTMAS TREE TO GARDEN TREE: Once Christmas is over, move your real tree back outdoors and continue caring for it as it grows. Fraser Firs are excellent evergreen trees for garden, bringing year-round foliage and structure rather than having its role end when the decorations come down.
ENJOY IT AGAIN IN YEARS TO COME: Caring for a pot-grown tree between Christmases gives it the opportunity to return to your home for future celebrations. Keep it growing outdoors during the rest of the year, and this potted real Christmas tree can become a Christmas tradition that grows with you, rather than a tree bought and replaced each season.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory
